title: Comparison and Logical Operators
instructions: Comparisons ask a yes/no question and give back 1 for true or 0 for false.
- ==  equal to (note: TWO equals signs; one = means 'copy into')
- &&  AND (true only if BOTH sides are true)
- ||  OR  (true if EITHER side is true)
task: Add the line that checks if a is less than b, so the output ends with:  a < b : 1
hint:
Use the < operator:

    printf("a < b : %d\n", a < b);
